description: Guided opt-out fer Hiya, which lists folk by phone number. One opt-out covers every saved phone number.
instructions: Hiya supplies caller ID to many Samsung phones an' carrier apps. Open Hiya's request form at https://hiyahelp.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new?ticket_form_id=33394399463699 an' ask Hiya to remove the caller ID name fer each of these numbers: {all_phones}. Use {contact_email} as yer email. Then smash "I've done this".
